before.test: a verified confirmation gets one acknowledgement only after the existing reply and playback drain
before.legacyCall: live.sendGameEvent('receipt-1', 'proposal-1', 'Engage the Latch: completed after your confirmation.')
before.assertion: The shipped adapter must request the missing acknowledgement after a safe boundary.
before.provenance: This test was written and executed before integration-source edits. It injected a fake socket and audio callbacks into the existing LiveVoice implementation; it was not a raw event replay of the historical real attempt.

after.command: GAME_DISABLE_LIVE=1 npx tsx --test tests/confirmation-acknowledgement.test.ts tests/confirmed-actions-client.test.ts && npm run typecheck
testNames: a verified confirmation gets one acknowledgement only after the existing reply and playback drain
receipt serialization carries only the exact robot result and known action; one idle request cannot become a second tool result
an immediate typed turn follows receipt context and suppresses the separate acknowledgement without losing input
immediate microphone speech cancels queued acknowledgement and keeps its audio and raw transcript
speech during the acknowledgement uses existing interruption guards and never requests a replacement acknowledgement
a player turn racing the owner HTTP receipt suppresses stale acknowledgement but retains the verified context
a confirmation HTTP race preserves microphone chunks after the receipt without mistaking silence for a user turn
decision input limits release every queued chunk once and a late receipt never requests stale speech
session readiness alone cannot race an unfinished greeting; conflicting duplicate receipt content is rejected
unresolved tool output and its ordinary continuation both precede a standalone acknowledgement
an unsafe opportunity expires once, with no polling, retry or later acknowledgement
Pause, explicit interruption and old-round replacement cancel queued speech without replaying the receipt
a chapter-advancing receipt retains its source; final-home closing never queues a second farewell
delayed pending and declined snapshots cannot replace a newer proposal at the same physical revision
proposal result is prompt, correlated and single; human projection and model claims never become execution receipts
verified owner receipt uses system context once without human transcript or second tool result; End cancels pending acknowledgement
Practice proposes physical work and ordinary consent never becomes a confirmation channel
after.retainedRegressionCommand: GAME_DISABLE_LIVE=1 npx tsx --test tests/voice.test.ts tests/voice-lifecycle.test.ts tests/voice-recovery.test.ts tests/voice-recovery-review.test.ts tests/voice-authority.test.ts && git diff --check

implementation.receiptContext: Exact server decision event/proposal/result retained locally; only whitelisted known action, robot outcome, source chapter and public checkpoint serialized.
implementation.standaloneAcknowledgement: At most one documented reply.create after a known reply.done boundary, resolved tool continuation/cancellation and drained playback.
implementation.inputPriority: Pending local decision buffers typed input and PCM briefly; valid receipt context is sent before buffered input. New typed input or detected provider speech suppresses standalone acknowledgement. Silence PCM alone does not.
implementation.limits: Expiry/size releases unchanged input rather than dropping it. A late receipt stays context-only. End clears timers and capture; existing final-home eight-second fallback unchanged.

limitations: Fake transport proof does not establish provider ingestion, model comprehension, or live acknowledgement behavior.
Input already transmitted before Confirm cannot be reordered. After bounded decision timeout/size release, an unavailable receipt cannot precede already released input.
Browser-hook and complete production validation are separate evidence owned by the release run.
No new token request, real provider connection, or accounting mutation was performed. Historical failed real evidence remains unchanged.
